column3: Cross Site Scripting Reflected -- must never be present
Server Side Code Injection -- must never be present
Path Traversal -- must never be present
Remote File Inclusion -- must never be present
External Redirect -- must never be present
Remote OS Command Injection -- must never be present
Remote OS Command Injection Time Based -- must never be present
SQL Injection -- this BFF has no SQL backend (config/scenarios/ is YAML files, not a database); kept visible as WARN rather than unlisted, not yet confirmed against a real scan
XSS Persistent in JSON Response -- likely false positive for a JSON-only API (ADP's own documented experience with a comparable FastAPI backend); not yet confirmed against this app's own scan
Server Error Response -- active-scan payloads can legitimately trigger a 4xx/5xx from input validation
Storable and Cacheable Content -- GET API responses are intentionally cacheable
